question: Solve: (64 ÷ 8) - 5 + 4 × 23 + 45 - 87
solution:
Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/648c3294b25194c752df3d2220347abffcd6d6a931d733d69f041ba631062591.png] 

**Calculation:**

(64 ÷ 8) - 5 + 4 × 23 + 45 - 87

⇒ 8 - 5 + 4 × 23 + 45 - 87

⇒ 8 - 5 + 92 + 45 - 87

⇒ 92 + 45 + 8 - 87 - 5 = 53

**∴ The correct option is 1**
